response.original_title: On the other side of the bridge are the things I never said
response.overview: After years without seeing each other, Mora reunites with Luna, her great unrequited love from her youth, hoping to recover the bond of friendship they once shared. During a dinner, Luna confesses that she had secretly been in love with her, and the silence they have kept for so long brings to the surface feelings and questions about what they might have experienced together.
response.tagline: Some things find their way back to us
response.title: On the other side of the bridge are the things I never said
